# automatick

> automatick is a library for building tick-based simulations in React. You provide `init` (initial state), `step` (state → next state), and a renderer; the library runs the animation loop, the play/pause/stop state machine, timing, controls, and optional Web Worker offloading.

Core model: a simulation is a single `defineSim({ defaultParams, init, step, shouldStop? })` module. Render it three ways — direct canvas (`useSimulationCanvas`, the common case), React DOM (`useSimulation` hook), or in a Web Worker for heavy `step` functions. The `<Simulation>` component wires state, controls, and timing together.

Install: `npm install automatick` (React 18+ peer dependency, optional). Import paths: `automatick/sim`, `automatick/react/simulation`, `automatick/react/hooks`, `automatick/react/canvas`.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/getting-started): Install and first simulation.
- [Without React](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/without-react): Use the engine standalone, no React.
- [With React](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/with-react): Render simulation state as JSX via the hook.
- [With Canvas](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/with-canvas): Render to a canvas with `useSimulationCanvas` (most common).
- [With Worker](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/with-worker): Offload an expensive `step` to a Web Worker.

## Guide

- [Tutorial](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/tutorial): End-to-end build of a simulation.
- [Defining a simulation](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/defining-a-sim): Rules for `init`, `step`, and `shouldStop`.
- [Simulation component](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/simulation-component): `<Simulation>` props and modes.
- [Using the hook](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/using-the-hook): Reading state with `useSimulation`.
- [Controls](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/controls): Wiring user-tweakable params to UI.
- [Canvas rendering](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/canvas-rendering): DPR handling, ImageData grids, draw loop.
- [Visualization patterns](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/guide/visualization-patterns): Agent, grid, trail, and theme-aware rendering recipes.

## API reference

- [defineSim](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/api/define-sim): Define a simulation module.
- [&lt;Simulation&gt;](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/api/simulation): The React component and its props.
- [useSimulation](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/api/use-simulation): Hook for subscribing to simulation state.
- [Controls](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/api/controls): Control primitives and the controls API.
- [createEngine](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/api/create-engine): Low-level engine without React.

## Examples

- [Dice](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/dice): Minimal React-DOM example.
- [Game of Life](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/game-of-life): Classic cellular automaton on a grid.
- [1D automata](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/automata-1d): Elementary one-dimensional rules.
- [Percolation](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/percolation): Cluster formation on a lattice.
- [Activators](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/activators): Reaction-style activation patterns.
- [Langton's ant](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/langton-ant): Turmite producing emergent highways.
- [Segregation](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/segregation): Schelling model with `shouldStop` at equilibrium.
- [N-body gravity](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/gravity): Particle gravity with trail rendering.
- [Boids](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/boids): Flocking agents.
- [Predator–Prey](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/predator-prey): Population dynamics.
- [Snake](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/snake): Grid game loop.
- [Mazes](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/mazes): Maze generation.
- [Chaos game](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/chaos-game): Fractal point plotting.
- [XOR ring](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/worker-canvas): Worker-mode canvas example.
- [Gray-Scott](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/gray-scott): Reaction-diffusion field.
- [Stable fluids](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/stable-fluids): Fluid solver.
- [Abelian sandpile](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/sandpile): Self-organized criticality.
- [SPH fluid](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/sph-fluid): Smoothed-particle hydrodynamics.
- [Ising model](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/ising): Statistical-mechanics spin lattice.
- [Ant colony](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/ant-colony): Pheromone-based foraging.
- [Traffic](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/traffic): Cellular traffic flow.
- [Falling sand](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/falling-sand): Falling-sand cellular automaton.
- [Settlement growth](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/settlement): Procedural settlement expansion.
- [Hydraulic erosion](https://jckr.github.io/automatick/examples/erosion): Terrain erosion simulation.

## Optional

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/automatick): Released versions.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jckr/automatick): Source, issues, and contribution guide.
